notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 18479 and 18637.
The description calls this 'A Closed Format Episode 1 deck'; format Episode I Closed Environment. Every card is an Episode I (Tatooine or Coruscant set) card.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: City Outskirts, Credits Will Do Fine, Podrace Prep, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer and Tatooine: Podrace Arena; these count toward the 60.

The list totals 65, as published: Characters is headed (27) but lists 28 cards, Weapons is headed (8) but lists 9, and the 'Epic Events' section (I Did It!) has no count. Section headers alone add to 63.

Posted 'The Hyperdrive Generator?s Gone/ We?ll New A New One' dested the Objective ('?' is a garbled apostrophe in the post); 'Taooine City Outskirts' Tatooine: City Outskirts; 'Podrace Preparations' Podrace Prep (the Light starting interrupt; the machine draft's Advance Preparation was wrong).
The Light pages are used for Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard and Tatooine: Mos Espa (the machine draft had the Dark pages).

Posted 'Qui-Gon?s Lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, after this post); 'Depa Billbila' Depa Billaba; 'Plo Kloon' Plo Koon; 'Ki-Adi Mundi' Ki-Adi-Mundi; 'Eithier Way, You Win' Either Way, You Win; 'Nabbo Blaster Rifle' Naboo Blaster Rifle; 'Are You Brain Dead?' Are You Brain Dead?!; 'I Did It' I Did It!.
Posted 'Mace Windu' dested the Coruscant Mace Windu (Mace Windu, Jedi Master is Theed Palace, after this post). Don't Do That Again is the Tatooine-set Light Effect.
The 'Epic Events' section header was mis-parsed by the machine draft as a card and is dropped.
The strategy section only says the strategy will be posted later.
